Title: Jeremiah in the Cistern
DateApprox: c. 588-586 BC (during the Babylonian siege of Jerusalem)
KeyPersons: Jeremiah; Ebed-Melech; Zedekiah, King of Judah
Events: During the siege, Jeremiah is arrested as a deserter, beaten, and lowered into a miry cistern to die, until Ebed-Melech pleads with Zedekiah and lifts him out with old rags and ropes.
